wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-mark-descr:
**NOTE: This API is internal and unstable, do not call this from API unless in code inside the WikimediaAntiAbuse extension.**

Records a review verdict on a revision. The `false-positive` verdict removes the reviewable tag and adds its false positive version, so the `mw-private-personal-info` tag becomes the `mw-private-personal-info-false-positive` tag. The `no-further-action` verdict adds the no further action version of the tag and keeps the tag that flagged the revision. Requires the ability to see the tag you are changing.
wikimediaantiabuse-api-review-unmark-des:
**NOTE: This API is internal and unstable, do not call this from API unless in code inside the WikimediaAntiAbuse extension.**

Removes a review verdict from a revision. Removing the `false-positive` verdict restores the reviewable tag in place of its false positive version. Removing the `no-further-action` verdict removes the no further action version of the tag, which puts the revision back in the review queue. Requires the ability to see the tag you are changing.
apihelp-query+abusereview-summary: List the edits that wait for review on [[{{#special:AbuseReview}}]].
apihelp-query+abusereview-extended-descr: Each request lists one tab of [[{{#special:AbuseReview}}]], chosen with <var>$1queue</var>. You need the same rights as for that tab. By default you get what the tab shows: edits that still need a review, newest first, without edits from the last few minutes if the tab delays new edits.
apihelp-query+abusereview-paramvalue-que: The Vandalism tab: edits that are likely vandalism.
The Personal information tab: edits that likely contain personal information.
apihelp-query+abusereview-param-showhand: Also list edits that no longer need a review: edits marked "no further action", and edits that were reverted, deleted or suppressed. Same as "{{int:wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-show-handled-revisions}}" on [[{{#special:AbuseReview}}]].
apihelp-query+abusereview-param-showfals: Also list edits marked as false positives. Same as "{{int:wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-show-false-positives}}" on [[{{#special:AbuseReview}}]].
apihelp-query+abusereview-param-showrece: Also list edits from the last few minutes, which some tabs hide for a while. Same as the "{{int:wikimediaantiabuse-special-abuse-review-filter-recent-edits-header}}" filter on [[{{#special:AbuseReview}}]]. The delay never applies to edits asked for with <var>$1revid</var>.
apihelp-query+abusereview-param-user: Only list edits by these users.
apihelp-query+abusereview-param-page: Only list edits to these pages.
apihelp-query+abusereview-paramvalue-pro: Adds the revision ID and the ID of the parent revision. Adds <samp>archived</samp> if the page is deleted.
Adds the title of the page.
Adds the time of the edit.

Adds the user who made the edit, and tells if the user is a temporary account or an IP address. If the user is hidden, adds <samp>userhidden</samp>. If it is hidden by suppression, also adds <samp>suppressed</samp>.
Adds the ID of the user who made the edit. If the user is hidden, adds <samp>userhidden</samp>. If it is hidden by suppression, also adds <samp>suppressed</samp>.
Adds the edit summary. If the edit summary is hidden, adds <samp>commenthidden</samp>. If it is hidden by suppression, also adds <samp>suppressed</samp>.
Adds the tags of the edit.

Adds why the edit is listed: <samp>unhandled</samp> (it needs a review), <samp>false-positive</samp> or <samp>no-further-action</samp> (a reviewer gave this verdict), or <samp>handled</samp> (it was dealt with in another way). For <samp>handled</samp>, <samp>handledreason</samp> tells how: <samp>reverted</samp>, <samp>revisiondeleted</samp>, <samp>pagedeleted</samp> or <samp>suppressed</samp>.
apihelp-query+abusereview-example-vandal: List the edits in the Vandalism tab that need a review.
apihelp-query+abusereview-example-all: List all edits in the Vandalism tab, with who made them, the edit summary and why each edit is listed.
apihelp-query+abusereview-example-genera: Get the text of the edits in the Vandalism tab that need a review.
apierror-wikimediaantiabuse-abusereview-: You don't have permission to view this AbuseReview queue.
